title: UI Theme Manifest Compiler
description: Verifies theme manifest: every semantic token mapped per mode, dark mode contrast, high-contrast opacity, token references valid, mode switching stability

pipeline.title: Parse Intent
pipeline.description: Extract color system, token spec, mode list (light/dark/high-contrast), override rules

pipeline.title: Verify Theme Manifest
pipeline.description: Run all gates against theme manifest spec

pipeline.title: Attest
pipeline.description: Produce signed theme artifact for component and page compilers

gates.title: Spec Valid
gates.description: theme-manifest-spec.json exists with modes, tokens, and mappings

gates.title: Modes Complete
gates.description: Every semantic token has a mapping for every declared mode

gates.title: Token References Valid
gates.description: Every mode mapping value references an existing primitive token or valid hex

gates.title: Dark Mode Contrast
gates.description: Dark mode foreground/background pairs declare contrast ratio ≥ 4.5:1

gates.title: High Contrast Opacity
gates.description: High-contrast mode has no token with opacity < 1 (no transparency)

gates.title: Mode Name Stability
gates.description: Token semantic names are identical across modes (only values change)

gates.title: No TODOs
gates.description: No TODO/FIXME/HACK in theme spec files

contracts.description: Structural requirements for a valid UI theme manifest

error_codes.UTH003: Theme mode mapping value references undefined token
error_codes.UTH004: Dark mode color pair fails WCAG contrast
error_codes.UTH005: High-contrast mode contains transparent or semi-transparent token
error_codes.UTH006: Token semantic name differs between modes (must be stable)
error_codes.UTH007: TODO/FIXME/HACK found in theme spec files
